references.text: Samson reveals the secret of his strength to Delilah—that his power lies in his hair, which has never been cut because of the Nazirite vow.
The angel of the Lord announces that Samson shall be a Nazirite from birth, and no razor shall touch his head.
The Nazirite law forbids a razor from touching the head during the vow period—the hair was a sign of consecration to God.
After his hair was cut, the power of the Lord left Samson, and the Philistines captured him and gouged out his eyes.
The Spirit of the Lord came upon Samson with power—the same power that now left him when his hair was cut.
Another reference to Nazirites' hair not being cut, in connection with Samuel's consecration.
